runtimes.value: MinerU package backend vlm-mlx-engine on Apple Silicon (since MinerU 2.6.3, macOS >= 13.5) and mineru-vl-utils[mlx] (mlx-vlm); community MLX builds (OpenGryd 8bit, playstonex 4bit); transformers >= 4.56 backend (slower); vLLM/SGLang are CUDA. Community GGUFs exist (mradermacher, 42ailab)
runtimes.note: The MLX backend is documented for MinerU2.5 (2509); Pro keeps the same architecture, so it should load, but no official statement found. llama.cpp support for the GGUFs (vision projector) unverified. Not in Ollama (only community tb-etl/mineru-q4km, unclear which version). Community native C++/MLX port mlx-mu targets the 2605 Pro model.
